What if the Sun never set again?
Wrong. It could become a living nightmare.
Imagine waking up... and the sky never turns dark again.
Your body clock starts breaking down. Millions struggle to sleep.
Nocturnal animals lose their natural rhythms. Entire ecosystems begin to change.
And in some regions, relentless sunlight could drive temperatures dangerously high.
If Earth became permanently locked facing the Sun, one side could burn under endless daylight...
While the other side freezes in eternal darkness.
So... which side would YOU choose?
